entries.clue: Pin the tail on the donkey or musical statues, for one
Pink-breasted garden singer with white wing flashes and a rattling downhill verse
Milliner for whom it is always six o'clock and always time for tea
Grey statue in the shallows that waits, stabs, and swallows the fish whole
Long-eared tea-table host whose springtime madness is proverbial
Long table you help yourself from
Rubber sphere blown up and knotted; it drifts to the ceiling with helium
Snow-white marsh bird with black legs and startling yellow feet
Jewelled headpiece worn by the girl whose night it is
Grey and white shore scavenger, raucous, bold and quick to steal chips
Hard white kidney fat, pressed into cakes for the winter garden
Gleeful snorting laugh coined in Jabberwocky, now a dictionary word
Cut down to a mere ten inches, the size Alice needs to fit the little door
